claims.detail: Committed exemplar: Synapse pause automation references occupancy sensors so nightly jobs still finish before the SLA window.

findings.description: Dedicated SQL pool idle windows on weekends justify pause-resume hooks without breaching 06:00 curation deadlines.
findings.recommendation: Coordinate pauses with ADF triggers and add preflight queries that abort pause when pipelines backlog.

findings.description: Power BI Premium nodes remain oversized relative to concurrent dataset refreshes after workspace consolidation.
findings.recommendation: Rightsize Premium SKUs once embedded refresh telemetry stabilizes for two billing cycles.
